evaluation_method: Blockbench reopened source, orthographic/editor views, texture inspection, rig hierarchy, and timeline clips

findings.animation: Short clips communicate anticipation, impact, recoil, and terminal death without uncontrolled overlap.
findings.bounds: Declared bounds enclose horns, moss plates, tail, and death rotation.
findings.controller_distance: Head/horn contrast and broad body mass remain readable at ordinary play distance.
findings.proportions: Four separated legs have sufficient swing clearance.
findings.rig: Eight semantic bones, joint pivots, and three gameplay locators are sufficient.
findings.silhouette: Heavy chest and forward horns clearly communicate a charge creature.
findings.texture: One opaque 64x64 atlas uses restrained low-frequency contrast.
